name: Outlook sync bootstrap
description: Initialize outlook_sync_state after OAuth connect. Run per principal (external_user_id).

steps.name: Map sync state row
steps.script:
local body = steps.get_profile.result.body or {}
local inbox_id = ""
for _, f in ipairs(steps.list_folders.result.folders or {}) do
  if f.display_name == "Inbox" then inbox_id = f.id break end
end
local after = input.backfill_after or "2026-01-01"
return {
  external_id = run.external_id,
  connection_id = input.connection_id or "",
  mailbox_email = body.mail or body.userPrincipalName or "",
  display_name = body.displayName or "",
  inbox_folder_id = inbox_id,
  delta_link = "",
  backfill_status = "pending",
  backfill_page_token = input.backfill_page_token,
  backfill_after = after,
  last_sync_at = input.synced_at,
  poll_interval_seconds = input.poll_interval_seconds or 120,
}

backfill_after.description: ISO date lower bound for backfill, e.g. 2026-01-01
